# @shihaoshen/dsh-project-agent-instructions
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Cordis plugin that loads project-level agent instruction files and injects
them into every agent's system prompt.
By default it reads **`.dsh/AGENTS.md`** from the session working directory, walking up through ance
stor directories until a match is found. Additional relative paths can be configured on the plugin's
s until a match is found. Additional relative paths can be configured on the plugin's settings page.
## Features
- Injects the nearest `.dsh/AGENTS.md` (project root and ancestors supported) into the system prompt

as a dedicated section.
- Custom additional read paths, relative to the project root.
- `.dsh/AGENT

S.md` is always included and cannot be removed from the read list.
- Configurable size limit with UT

F-8-safe truncation (default 32768 bytes).
- File watching: edits to the instruction file are picked

up automatically without restarting.
- Settings page in the DSH Web UI (Plugins → this plugin), cha

y without restarting.
- Settings page in the DSH Web UI (Plugins → this plugin), changes apply live.
